content.question: What is the core idea behind t-SNE?
options: Points that are far apart in high-dimensional space should stay far apart, while nearby points may end up separated.
Similar data points in high-dimensional space should be represented as nearby points in the low-dimensional space, and vice versa.
All variance in the data should be concentrated in the first component.
Every class should be represented by its own covariance matrix.
content.answer: Similar data points in high-dimensional space should be represented as nearby points in the low-dimensional space, and vice versa.
